notes:
{金|きん} has three main uses: the metal gold, the color gold, and as an abbreviation for Friday.

COMPOUNDS (metal):
- {金|きん}⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧ (gold medal)
- ⟦{純金|じゅんきん}→純金：16997_junkin⟧ (pure gold)
- ⟦{金貨|きんか}→金貨：14466_kinka⟧ (gold coin)
- ⟦{金塊|きんかい}→金塊：27892_kinkai⟧ (gold bar/ingot)

COMPOUNDS (color):
- {金|きん}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (gold color, golden)
- ⟦{金髪|きんぱつ}→金髪：14443_kinpatsu⟧ (blond hair)

USAGE (Friday):
{金|きん} = ⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧ (Friday). Used in schedules: ⟦{月|げつ}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦{水|すい}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧{金|きん} (Mon/Wed/Fri).
In speech, Friday is ⟦{金曜|きんよう}→金曜：31370_kinyou⟧ or ⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧; bare {金|きん} for Friday belongs to written schedules and lists, and to runs of days said aloud ({月|げつ}{水|すい}{金|きん}, {月|げつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金|きん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧ (silver)
- ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧ (copper/bronze)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧: money
- {金|きん}: gold (metal)
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧: money (polite)
The kanji is the same but the reading determines the meaning.
